social_gift_epochs.purpose: Named generation fence only; no independent mutable send/claim counters
social_gift_epochs.parent_fence: SocialRoot360 serializes enumeration and absent-key creation
social_gift_epochs.time: Reject generation regression versus greatest existing generation and at before owner updated_at; never recycle old generation

constraints: sender != recipient; positive IDs, generation, version; amount = qualified immutable vector
send operation unique with identity/fingerprint conflict detection
recipient+notice identity unique; typed source reconstructs exact natural key
claim fields all null or all nonnull; no claimed-to-unclaimed transition
No expiry or destructive retention: unclaimed persists through day/relation/content changes
social_gift_transfers.foreign_keys: No sender/profile CASCADE. Receiver canonical player FK RESTRICT, not CASCADE; physical receiver deletion is explicitly blocked until an I4 deletion/entitlement policy is separately qualified. Epoch historical IDs and sender identity survive profile removal. No resurrection of a deleted sender profile.

social_gift_claim_operations.purpose: Immutable committed claim batch fact links all transfers to one Grant; not an independent quota counter
social_gift_claim_operations.identity: Operation ID minted once before retry, retained for exact unknown-COMMIT resolution; fingerprint checks conflict, never creates identity

quota_truth.send: Count durable transfers issued by sender in sender generation, at most10; unique directed recipient per sender generation even after delete/re-friend
quota_truth.receive: Count transfers whose claim recipient and claim_generation match current receiver generation, at most10; old-day issued gifts can be claimed in current claim day
quota_truth.epoch: Epoch is fence, transfer facts are quota truth. No daily destructive reset job

notice_truth: SocialInbox owns notice row/sequence/dismissal. Type4 + finite source social-gift.transfer.v1 points to canonical transfer; type alone never proves value.
deletion_qualification: Existing projection forbids fabricated profiles; deleted sender may make retained gift inaccessible through stock notice view. Value remains durable; this seal does not claim a new stock recovery UI or I4 physical-deletion support.
migration: Next neutral migration expected00036, verify actual frontier before assigning. New empty owner tables/indexes/checks only; no retroactive gifts/coin credits, no rewriting migrations1..35. Default routes/producers stay inactive.
indexes: operation identity and exact source identity unique indexes

named_generation_reuse.existing_types: Reuse domain/generation GenerationID, AuthorityScope and GenerationRef with domain social-gift and player scope; do not invent a generic generation aggregate. Existing I6A TimedRunner/Binder gives stable database time. ReconcileKernel owns no Gift tables and creates no fabricated epoch state.
named_generation_reuse.named_identity: GiftEpoch key is player+SOCIAL_GIFT_DAY_V1+calendar token; persist a distinct typed GenerationID UUID minted from stable backend operation entropy at first creation, retained across retry and restore. Calendar token and UUID/operation/transfer/claim identities are distinct. Existing epoch wins under360/371; never manufacture new UUID for an existing day.
named_generation_reuse.facts: Transfer snapshots sender GenerationID plus calendar token and policy revision; claim records receiver GenerationID and claim calendar token. Facts derive quotas for exact named day. Purging epoch/facts cannot permit uniqueness reset.
provider_prerequisites: Accepted I6A generation identity/time contracts; original I7A1 aliases I5_GRANT/I6A_NAMED_EPOCH remain exact contract providers

authority_condition: Valid owning HOT649 content seal and sole ObjectRegistry selection; this is design authority only, not product acceptance
